MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #1 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Fill the blank with the word that means "am called": 你好!我____小明。 (1 mark)
   A. 有
   B. 是
   C. 去
   D. 叫

2. How does the voice move in the fourth tone? (1 mark)
   A. It rises
   B. It stays flat
   C. It dips and rises
   D. It falls sharply

3. Which word means "younger sister"? (1 mark)
   A. 女儿 nǚ'ér
   B. 姐姐 jiějie
   C. 妈妈 māma
   D. 妹妹 mèimei

4. Read the pinyin: nà shì wǒ gēge. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. Who is this?
   B. This is my father.
   C. That is my older brother.
   D. There are five people in my family.

5. Why is it a good habit to keep household items in their proper places? (1 mark)
   A. It keeps the home tidy and safe
   B. It makes things harder to find
   C. It makes the house noisy
   D. It wastes time

6. What does 下 (xià) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Where
   B. Under
   C. To put
   D. Bathroom

7. Which pair of numbers is easily mixed up in sound? (1 mark)
   A. sān (3) and bā (8)
   B. liù (6) and qī (7)
   C. sì (4) and shí (10)
   D. yī (1) and èr (2)

8. Which sentence means "Today is Wednesday."? (1 mark)
   A. 星期五,去清真寺。
   B. 我星期三去学校。
   C. 今天星期三。
   D. 星期天,去教堂。

9. Which word means "gift"? (1 mark)
   A. 盘子
   B. 蜡烛
   C. 杯子
   D. 礼物

10. In the text 今天是我的生日。朋友们来我家。我很高兴。 what is the main idea? (1 mark)
   A. A happy birthday with friends
   B. A sad day
   C. A lesson at school
   D. A trip to the market

11. Which Chinese word means "dinner"? (1 mark)
   A. 牛肉 niúròu
   B. 喜欢 xǐhuan
   C. 午饭 wǔfàn
   D. 晚饭 wǎnfàn

12. Which verb goes with 茶? (1 mark)
   A. 喝
   B. 吃
   C. 去
   D. 是

13. What does 摸鼻子 mō bízi tell you to do? (1 mark)
   A. Cover your mouth
   B. Wash your nose
   C. Look at your nose
   D. Touch your nose

14. What does 哭 (kū) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Hand
   B. To cry
   C. To wash hands
   D. To laugh, to smile

15. Which sentence means "The wind is very strong."? (1 mark)
   A. 今天天气很好。
   B. 这是太阳。
   C. 风很大。
   D. 太阳很大。

16. What does 下雨 (xià yǔ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. It rains
   B. Weather
   C. There is not
   D. Wind

17. Which sentence describes the position of the window above the sofa? (1 mark)
   A. 沙发在窗户上面。
   B. 窗户在沙发上面。
   C. 浴室在花园旁边。
   D. 沙发在门旁边。

18. Which word is pronounced huāyuán? (1 mark)
   A. 花园
   B. 窗户
   C. 电视
   D. 沙发

19. What does 早上好 (zǎoshang hǎo) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Good morning
   B. Goodbye
   C. Thank you
   D. I, me

20. What does 早上好 zǎoshang hǎo mean? (1 mark)
   A. Good morning
   B. Good night
   C. Goodbye
   D. Thank you

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Write the Chinese words for head, hand and foot, with pinyin. (3 marks)

22. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Where is the sofa?" (2 marks)

23. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Hello, teacher!" (2 marks)

24. Give two habits of an active listener. (2 marks)

25. Explain one similarity and one difference between naming the days in Kiswahili and Chinese. (4 marks)

26. Write two strategies for speaking Chinese clearly. (3 marks)

27. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The wind is very strong." (2 marks)

28. Write these position words in Chinese with pinyin: beside, above and below. (3 marks)

29. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The bed is in the bedroom." and "The television is on the table." (4 marks)

30. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Thank you!" (2 marks)

31. Name two fruits, one vegetable and one drink in Chinese with pinyin. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #1 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — 叫
   我叫 introduces a name.

2. D — It falls sharply
   The fourth tone falls quickly from high to low.

3. D — 妹妹 mèimei
   妹妹 is a younger sister and 姐姐 is an older sister.

4. C — That is my older brother.
   nà shì wǒ gēge. is 那是我哥哥。, which means "That is my older brother.".

5. A — It keeps the home tidy and safe
   Things in the right place are easy to find and do not cause accidents.

6. B — Under
   下 (xià) means under.

7. C — sì (4) and shí (10)
   sì has an s sound and shí has an sh sound.

8. C — 今天星期三。
   今天星期三。 (jīntiān xīngqīsān.) means "Today is Wednesday.".

9. D — 礼物
   礼物 lǐwù is a gift.

10. A — A happy birthday with friends
   The text is about a birthday, friends coming and being happy.

11. D — 晚饭 wǎnfàn
   晚饭 (wǎnfàn) means dinner.

12. A — 喝
   We drink tea, so we use 喝.

13. D — Touch your nose
   摸 is to touch.

14. B — To cry
   哭 (kū) means to cry.

15. C — 风很大。
   风很大。 (fēng hěn dà.) means "The wind is very strong.".

16. A — It rains
   下雨 (xià yǔ) means it rains.

17. B — 窗户在沙发上面。
   上面 means above.

18. A — 花园
   花园 is pronounced huāyuán and means garden.

19. A — Good morning
   早上好 (zǎoshang hǎo) means good morning.

20. A — Good morning
   早上 is morning and 好 is good.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: 头 tóu, 手 shǒu, 脚 jiǎo.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: 沙发在哪儿? shāfā zài nǎr?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: 老师好! lǎoshī hǎo!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

24. (2 marks)
   Answer: Face the speaker and stay quiet; listen for key words; nod or show you are following.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each habit.

25. (4 marks)
   Answer: Similarity: both use numbers to make day names. Difference: Chinese counts from Monday (星期一 is week one) but Kiswahili counts from Saturday (Jumatatu, Monday, has tatu, three).
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for the similarity and 2 marks for the difference with an example.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: Listen first and copy the tone with your hand; say it slowly then faster; record yourself and compare.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each strategy, 1 mark for explaining how it helps.

27. (2 marks)
   Answer: 风很大。 fēng hěn dà.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: 旁边 pángbiān, 上面 shàngmiàn, 下面 xiàmiàn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

29. (4 marks)
   Answer: 床在卧室。 chuáng zài wòshì. 电视在桌子上。 diànshì zài zhuōzi shàng.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: 谢谢! xièxie!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

31. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example 芒果 mángguǒ, 香蕉 xiāngjiāo, 菠菜 bōcài, 茶 chá.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for fruits, 1 mark for vegetable, 1 mark for drink.
